topIssues.title: C-flake: TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_ELSync (Short, Long, RestartOpNode)
topIssues.author: ajsutton
topIssues.body:
**Claude:** Tracking flaky test investigation.

**Test:** `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_ELSync_Short`, `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_ELSync_Long`, `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_ELSync_RestartOpNode_Long`
**Package:** `github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/op-acceptance-tests/tests/depreqres/syncmodereqressync/elsync`
**Job:** `memory-all` (flake-shake gate)
**Flakes:** 1 each in recent CI data

All three tests share the same `UnsafeChainNotStalling_Disconnect` / `UnsafeChainNotStalling_RestartOpNode` helpers. The helpers use `time.Sleep` for disconnect duration and P2P disconnect/reconnect patterns that may be timing-sensitive under CI load. The `stableSyncStatus` helper polls for head stabilization but uses a 5-second timeout that may be insufficient.

topPRs.title: test(kona-proof-interop): EIP-2935 fixture-based integration test
topPRs.author: digorithm
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Adds fixture-based integration tests for `OracleInteropProvider::header_by_number` in `kona-proof-interop`
- Uses real OP Mainnet state/storage trie proof data captured via `cast proof` to exercise the EIP-2935 block hash lookup path
- Tests the full code path: Isthmus activation check → `eip_2935_history_lookup` (real trie traversal) → `header_by_hash` resolution
- Fixture: safe head block 149,340,000 → target block 149,331,809 (exactly 8,191 blocks behind, at EIP-2935 window boundary)

### Tests added
- `test_header_by_number_eip2935_fast_path` — full EIP-2935 lookup with real OP Mainnet trie data
- `test_header_by_number_block_past_head` — error when requesting block past safe head
- `test_header_by_number_same_block` — identity case (requesting the safe head itself)
- `test_header_by_number_missing_chain_id` — error when chain ID not in config

Refs: #18288

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo nextest run --package kona-proof-interop` — all 27 tests pass (23 existing + 4 new)
- [x] `cargo clippy -p kona-proof-interop --lib --tests` — no warnings in `kona-proof-interop`
- [x] No production code modified — only new test code and fixture data

### Fixture data capture (reproducibility)

```bash
# OP Mainnet RPC
RPC=https://mainnet.optimism.io

# Blocks chosen: safe head N=149340000, target M=149331809 (N-M=8191, at window boundary)
# Ring buffer slot: 149340000 % 8191 = 1688
SLOT=$(python3 -c "print(hex(1688))")

# EIP-2935 history storage contract
ADDR=0x0000F90827F1C53a10cb7A02335B175320002935

# Capture state+storage proof at safe head
cast proof $ADDR $SLOT --block 149340000 --rpc-url $RPC

# Capture block headers
cast block 149340000 --rpc-url $RPC --json
cast block 149331809 --rpc-url $RPC --json

# Verify: storage value at slot 1688 = target block hash
cast block 149331809 --rpc-url $RPC -f hash
# 0xaef335ed650ddd1da95a19930fdeab946485540a23e41965f96252089a04ddfd
```

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

### Follow-up

Once this PR lands in `develop` we should remove the original action test (`op-supervisor`-based) for this EIP-2935 path.

topPRs.title: fix(kona/genesis): continue past malformed logs in update_with_receipts
topPRs.author: sebastianst
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- `SystemConfig::update_with_receipts` used `try_for_each` which short-circuited on the first malformed config update log, silently dropping any subsequent valid updates in the same block
- Changed to process each log independently: valid updates are applied, malformed ones are skipped — matching the op-node reference in `UpdateSystemConfigWithL1Receipts` (`system_config.go:42-67`)
- Refactored return type from `Result<bool, SystemConfigUpdateError>` to `(Vec<SystemConfigUpdateKind>, Vec<SystemConfigUpdateError>)` so callers get full visibility into what succeeded and what failed
- Added `Display` derive to `SystemConfigUpdateKind` for human-readable log messages
- Deduplicated the two traversal callers into a shared `update_system_config_with_receipts` helper
- Updated the attributes caller to log individual updates/errors instead of a single blanket warning

Related: fixes remaining Issue 2 from https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism-private/issues/507 . Issue 1 was already fixed by #19358 and #19503.

## Test plan

- [x] Added `test_update_with_receipts_continues_past_malformed_log` — sends a malformed batcher update followed by a valid gas limit update in the same receipt; asserts the malformed one is skipped (batcher address unchanged) and the valid one is applied (gas limit updated)
- [x] Red/green confirmed: test fails against the old `try_for_each` code, passes with the fix
- [x] All 20 `kona-genesis` config tests pass
- [x] All 6 `kona-derive` system config / syscfg tests pass

topPRs.title: test(kona-proof-interop): add multi-iteration EIP-2935 test
topPRs.author: digorithm
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Follow-up to #19726. Adds a test for the multi-iteration EIP-2935 lookup case where the target block is beyond the 8,191-block history window, as requested in [review](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19726#discussion_r2113282170).

- **New test**: `test_header_by_number_eip2935_multi_iteration` — target is 8,196 blocks behind safe head, requiring two EIP-2935 lookups through an intermediate block
- **Unified fixture format**: Both single and multi-iteration tests now share one `FixtureData` struct with a `steps: Vec<ProofStep>` array. Each step holds account/storage proof nodes and the resolved block header. Eliminates duplicate structs and loaders.

### How the multi-iteration lookup works

1. **Iteration 1**: Target outside window (N-M=8,196 > 8,191) → reads slot `N % 8191` from safe head's state → returns hash of oldest block in window (intermediate)
2. **Iteration 2**: Target inside window (I-M=5 ≤ 8,191) → reads slot `M % 8191` from intermediate block's state → returns actual target hash

Fixture contains two sets of `eth_getProof` data (at safe head and at intermediate block) plus three block headers.

Refs: #18288

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo nextest run --package kona-proof-interop` — all 28 tests pass
- [x] `cargo clippy -p kona-proof-interop --all-targets --all-features` — no warnings
- [x] No production code modified
